purpose: Teach: かねて/余暇/車中/留まる/論拠/言い過ぎ/御用/競走

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、この研究、本気で、絶対、かねて、絶対、から、絶対、注目していたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I've been watching this research of yours for a long time. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Steady, measured opening. Direct eye contact. Weight behind the words but no theatrics. Pause after the name. Conviction on the close without being harsh.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。私の、本気で、絶対、余暇、絶対、研究に、絶対、充てております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm dedicating my free time entirely to this research. Thank you for your confidence.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal register. Careful articulation. A little nervous energy underneath but controlled. Slight bow in the voice on gratitude — genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学会出張の、本気で、絶対、車中、絶対、で、絶対、論文構想、絶対、練ってこい、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: On the conference trip — I want you working on your paper outline during the drive. Get it solid.
lines.style: Practical, instructive tone. Not a suggestion. Clipped delivery. The voice of someone who knows how to use travel time. Slight lean forward on the directive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。私、本気で、絶対、研究に、絶対、留まる、絶対、ことなく、絶対、実地調査も、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm not just staying within the library work — I'm also conducting field research to support it. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Earnest and detailed. He's thinking through his answer as he speaks. Slightly faster on the concrete example to show competence. Softer on the close, acknowledging the mentor's push.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の、本気で、絶対、論拠、絶対、強固に、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure your paper's foundation is solid. No weak arguments.
lines.style: Sharp, economical. Staccato on the main point. This is the experienced voice cutting through to what matters. No room for interpretation. Finality in the tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授に、本気で、絶対、言い過ぎ、絶対、ない、絶対、よう、絶対、慎重に、絶対、お伝えします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll make sure to convey that to my advisor carefully — nothing overreaching. Thank you.
lines.style: Slightly flustered. He's caught the warning and is thinking about how he's been presenting to his other mentor. Quick clarification. Humble close. The relief of being kept honest.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学術界の、本気で、絶対、御用、絶対、学者、絶対、にならぬよう、絶対、独立した立場を、絶対、保て、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Don't become someone's puppet in academia. Maintain your independence. That's what matters.
lines.style: Serious philosophical weight. Slight slowdown on the core message. This is the mentor's real concern underneath the critique. Warm but uncompromising. A kind of fatherly authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会での、本気で、絶対、競走、絶対、激しい中、絶対、私、絶対、独自性、絶対、保ってまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Even with all the competition in academia, I'll hold onto my own voice. Thank you for this.
lines.style: Resolute, almost quietly fierce. He's hearing the warning and taking it as permission to push back against what others might expect. Slight nod in the rhythm. Close with sincere gratitude, not relief.
